Name: iKeychain's Portraits (Unfinished)
Author: ikeychain
Description:
This changes some portraits in the game into my artstyle. I've had people begging me to release these, even though I'm not even close to being done. [b]Feedback is appreciated. [/b]I do not know if I will ever finish an entire set, as it is a lot of work. [b]If I get enough feedback & support, then I may become more inspired to finish these.

[i]This is only available to download on Nexusmods.com, if you find it elsewhere, it is taken without permission. [/i]

[list]
[*][b]3/11/2019[/b] (0.2) - Uploaded for the first time, only contains Abigail & Leah. 
[*]3/11/2019 (0.2.1) - Got rid of a stray transparency pixel on Abby's blushing portrait.
[/list][/b]
